title: Leather Armour
html:
Leather Armour is a common Light Armour. It is the starter Armour for Rangers.

Dark, messy stains line the armholes of the well-used leather breastplate.

Where to find

  • On the edge of the small pool in the Nymph's Grotto in Sharess' Caress on Wyrm's Crossing at X: 27 Y: 93
  • Worn by  Fist Recruit Tristan

Notes

  • This model is not compatible with larger body models such as Half-Elf body type 4 or with smaller body models such as gnomes. The arms and legs appear normally but the torso is invisible.
